about: Decisions a person made on what the catalog build left for review (docs/catalog-review.md), so each build applies them instead of listing them again. A decision only chooses among what the sources say, or says how a source is read; it never adds a value no source gives (docs/catalog-sources.md, "Decisions"). `form`: a cultivar with no page of its own, whose species' sources list it as a tree: the forms it takes, primary first, each listed by a species source. `edible`: a plant a source calls edible that is rated toxic: true writes the source's "edible", with what it lists as poisonous beside it (`poison`), where it lists any; false leaves edible as it was, taking out an older unsourced "yes". `nativeShown`: a plant the catalog calls exotic that Kew's checklist has native in some states: shown native there all the same. `kewNames`: names Kew's checklist could read two ways, checked to be read as Kew's accepted name, whose authors (`author`) it records. `genusPage`: a plant read from NC State's page for its whole genus, the facts checked to fit it. `split`: a record of several cultivars made one record per cultivar (scripts/catalog/split.mjs): the record keeps its id for one cultivar (`keep`, the one whose size it showed), and each other gets a record of its own, from its own NC State page (`page`) or, with none, names alone, taking its species' size until a source gives its own. An other with `species` is filed by its page under a species Kew keeps apart from its own, and goes under Kew's; one with `botanical` is a plant the record named that isn't one of its cultivars (its genus, or a species), with the page ncsu-pages.json gives it, if any; an entry's `species` is the species record to make where the catalog has none. `cultivar`: a record naming one cultivar beside its species, renamed for it. `kewSpecies`: a cultivar NC State files under a species Kew keeps apart from its own (its page says which it is), put under Kew's species (docs/catalog-sources.md, "Kew's species"). `parent`: a cultivar put under a species its name doesn't give, where its page names it. `fold`: a record whose plants all have records of their own: it goes, and the catalog's `meta.moved` says which record its id stands for from then on (`into`). `group`: a record kept for a group of cultivars, read from its species' page as its own, its size included. `leads`: a fact its sources are far apart on (docs/catalog-review.md, "Sizes whose sources are far apart"): the source that leads it (`source`), the others confirming it or shown as its alternate. `checkOnly`: a source often far off the authorities (docs/catalog-review.md, "Sources often far from the authorities"): what it says goes only to the review, never deciding a value, backing one or shown as its alternate (docs/catalog-sources.md, "A source that's often far off").

width.why: NC State gives a tree 50–75 ft tall a width of 4–6 ft; the Arboretum's 50–100 ft fits its height (Jason: fix white poplar, 2026-10-29)
